name: Keep the time the same
rule: A passage stays in one time unless something changes it.
A story told in the past keeps its verbs in the past.

wrong.text: Last night we went to the hall, but the show starts late.

right.text: Last night we went to the hall, but the show started late.

spot: Read the lines before. Which time is the passage in? Check this verb fits.
deeper: 'Had' + third form: an earlier past, before another past event.
Facts that are always true stay in today's time: the sun rises in the east.
After 'when' or 'if' about the future, use today's form: when he arrives, we will eat.
